title: Betta Fish Tank Mates and Compatibility | BettaFish.website
description: Evaluate betta tank mates, territory, aquarium size and separation plans before combining animals.
h1: Compatibility is a risk assessment, not a list
intro: Betta fish tank mates require individual risk assessment because a betta may still reject a generally compatible species. Aquarium size, cover, behaviour and a backup enclosure all matter.

sections.heading: What a compatibility decision needs
paragraphs: Compare temperature, water, activity level, fin-nipping risk, territory and feeding competition rather than relying on a yes-or-no label.
Any combined setup needs observation and a practical separation plan before the animals are introduced.
